description: Synthetic experimental RFC-012 request traces. The reference host is deterministic: epoch-1, lease-1 onward, clock in Unix ms. Each trace starts fresh. Control steps are trusted host-side stimuli, never wire methods. Nonempty expected state objects are partial assertions; empty objects and arrays compare exactly. There is no Portal/STT or production-host validation claim.

traces.name: replacement-and-one-final
traces.description: A revision replaces words, and retrying complete returns the receipt without a second canonical message.

traces.name: final-without-updates
traces.description: An admitted stream may finalize without a provisional snapshot; thread and author come from its lease.

traces.name: final-only-mode
traces.description: No provisional consumer is required for exactly one canonical final.

traces.name: duplicate-stale-and-conflicting-update
traces.description: Duplicates and older revisions do not consume rate allowance or replace the current snapshot.

traces.name: final-must-match-same-revision
traces.description: Finalization may confirm an existing revision only with identical text.

traces.name: stale-terminal-methods
traces.description: Complete and abort cannot act on a revision older than the accepted snapshot.

traces.name: abort-is-not-speech
traces.description: Abort removes provisional text, can be retried, and never promotes the partial.

traces.name: update-rate-and-terminal-bypass
traces.description: A new snapshot exceeds the rate limit; an immediate final does not wait behind it.

traces.name: rate-boundary-is-inclusive
traces.description: At exactly one permitted interval, the next replacement is accepted.

traces.name: expiry-cleans-without-another-packet
traces.description: The host expires volatile state on its clock; late data cannot revive it.

traces.name: host-shortens-expiry
traces.description: The host's shortened deadline, not the requested one, ends the lease.

traces.name: reconnect-invalidates-lease
traces.description: An epoch change aborts provisional state, and the new epoch doesn't know the old stream.

traces.name: unknown-stream-cannot-update
traces.description: An update before admitted open is rejected.

traces.name: grant-revocation-cleans-stream
traces.description: Restoring a revoked grant does not revive the old lease.

traces.name: channel-replacement-invalidates-binding
traces.description: Reusing a channel id with another registration generation does not transfer the lease.

traces.name: sender-revocation-cleans-stream
traces.description: The authenticated sender association is checked again at receipt.

traces.name: channel-removal-cleans-stream
traces.description: A removed descriptor cannot receive a final merely because it was once registered.

traces.name: mismatched-leaseId
traces.description: A lifecycle packet must carry its stream's lease.

traces.name: same-open-retry
traces.description: Identical open returns the original lease and limits; changed identity conflicts.

traces.name: reserved-message-identity
traces.description: Two streams cannot both reserve the same canonical message identity.

traces.name: completed-message-identity-survives-reconnect
traces.description: A fresh stream cannot redeliver a completed canonical message.

traces.name: terminal-replay-expires
traces.description: Terminal receipts are replayable only while the lease is valid.

traces.name: bounded-admission-includes-receipts
traces.description: The reference host fails closed at its stream budget rather than forgetting replay protection.

traces.name: final-ingress-rejection-is-not-completion
traces.description: Rejected final routing leaves the lease open and never records an accepted receipt.

traces.name: unicode-scalar-size
traces.description: One supplementary scalar counts as one character, and combining marks remain separate scalars.

traces.name: unicode-is-not-normalized
traces.description: The host compares and stores precomposed and decomposed text exactly as sent.

traces.name: reject-high-surrogate
traces.description: Lone UTF-16 surrogates are not Unicode scalar text.

traces.name: reject-low-surrogate
traces.description: Lone UTF-16 surrogates are not Unicode scalar text.

traces.name: empty-final-is-valid-text
traces.description: An empty snapshot is a legal text value; the host's ordinary ingress may apply policy separately.

traces.name: invalid-zero-revision
traces.description: Malformed lifecycle fields cannot change admitted state.

traces.name: invalid-fractional-revision
traces.description: Malformed lifecycle fields cannot change admitted state.

traces.name: invalid-unsafe-revision
traces.description: Malformed lifecycle fields cannot change admitted state.

traces.name: invalid-missing-text
traces.description: Malformed lifecycle fields cannot change admitted state.

traces.name: invalid-array-text
traces.description: Malformed lifecycle fields cannot change admitted state.

traces.name: invalid-unknown-tag
traces.description: Malformed lifecycle fields cannot change admitted state.

traces.name: invalid-abort-reason
traces.description: Abort uses a closed reason vocabulary.

traces.name: open-no-new-grant
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-new-grant-without-base
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-one-segment-wildcard
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-legacy-incoming-boolean
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-legacy-channel-boolean
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-advertisement-without-base
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-pre-policy
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-unregistered-channel
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-forbidden-channel
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: open-unauthenticated-sender
traces.description: Admission is gated by actual advertised support, current authority, channel registration, and sender association.

traces.name: intentional-depth-three-wildcard
traces.description: A matching one-segment pattern at the right depth can grant an explicitly advertised leaf.

traces.name: admission-before-text-processing
traces.description: An unauthorized completion carrying oversized text fails authority before payload treatment.

traces.name: open-after-terminal
traces.description: Replaying accepted open never reports an ended stream as open.

traces.name: changed-final-retry
traces.description: A changed complete on a completed stream conflicts without changing the canonical final.

traces.name: alias-preserves-canonical-identity
traces.description: The host's stable channel identity, not its wire spelling, deduplicates a committed message.

traces.name: unrelated-binding-is-not-a-duplicate
traces.description: The same wire channelId and messageId on a different actual channel are distinct messages.

traces.name: unrelated-principal-is-not-a-duplicate
traces.description: Canonical keys include the authenticated server principal, not just a claimed channel and message.

traces.name: outbound-descriptor-cannot-receive
traces.description: Registered outbound-only channels do not authorize provisional incoming content.

traces.name: invalid-open-identifier-too-long
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-identifier-surrogate
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-name-too-long
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-name-surrogate
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-timestamp-too-large
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-timestamp-negative
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-timestamp-fractional
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-missing-message-id
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-extra-sender-authority
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: invalid-open-open-cannot-carry-text
traces.description: Invalid envelope metadata cannot allocate a lease.

traces.name: abort-at-rate-boundary
traces.description: Cancellation is not held back by the previous update's cadence.

traces.name: oversized-stale-text
traces.description: Even an ignored stale update must obey text limits.

traces.name: receipt-replay-rechecks-authority
traces.description: An already completed request does not bypass a grant revocation.

traces.name: stable-binding-change-invalidates-lease
traces.description: Changing the trusted underlying channel invalidates a lease even if generation was not incremented.

traces.name: unregistered-dictionary-name-constructor
traces.description: Inherited Object members are not registered channels.

traces.name: unregistered-dictionary-name-__proto__
traces.description: Inherited Object members are not registered channels.

traces.name: registered-dictionary-name
traces.description: A genuinely registered own entry remains usable even when its name matches an Object prototype member.

traces.name: readiness-lapse-keeps-lease
traces.description: Policy that stops being ready rejects calls meanwhile, but it isn't an invalidation: the lease stands and takes updates once policy is ready again.

traces.name: revocation-during-readiness-lapse-ends-lease
traces.description: A grant reduction that lands while policy isn't ready still ends the lease (RFC §8); policy being ready again with both grants restored doesn't revive it.

traces.name: revocation-with-readiness-lapse-ends-lease
traces.description: A grant reduction in the same policy change that makes policy not ready still ends the lease (RFC §8); restoring both doesn't revive it.

traces.name: readiness-lapse-expiry-ends-lease
traces.description: A deadline reached while policy isn't ready still ends the lease as expired (RFC §8): a lapse doesn't stop the clock. A late call is refused for readiness first, as RFC §11 orders, and as expired once policy is ready again.

traces.name: readiness-lapse-channel-removal-ends-lease
traces.description: Removing the channel while policy isn't ready still ends the lease (RFC §8); restoring the same registration, with policy ready again, doesn't revive it.

traces.name: readiness-lapse-channel-replacement-ends-lease
traces.description: Registering the channel again, under a new generation, while policy isn't ready still ends the lease (RFC §4.1, §8); a later call finds a binding that no longer matches.

traces.name: authority-precedes-open-shape
traces.description: Ready state and the grant are checked before the open's members, so an open with an invalid member reports the lifecycle or authority reason first.

traces.name: authority-precedes-envelope-shape
traces.description: A grant reduction ends the stream, and an update after it is refused for the missing grant before its envelope's shape is checked: its revision of 0 would be invalid params.

traces.name: stricter-mode-invalidates-lease
traces.description: A policy change to a mode narrower than a lease's ends that lease, clearing its snapshot and preparation, rather than leaving the wider receipt standing.

traces.name: expiry-precedes-mode-narrowing
traces.description: A control step is one Host event at its new time. A lease whose deadline that time has passed had expired (RFC §8), so a mode narrowing in the same step finds it expired, not open to abort.

traces.name: expired-stream-id-reuse
traces.description: Expiry precedes replay handling: reusing an expired stream's ID, even with changed params, reports expired rather than conflict.

traces.name: invalid-open-allocates-no-lease
traces.description: A refused open allocates nothing: the next accepted open receives the first lease.

traces.name: broader-mode-keeps-lease-mode
traces.description: A lease keeps the mode its receipt announced: after the Host's mode broadens, a final-only lease's snapshot is still not presented, while a new lease takes the broader mode.

traces.name: reused-stream-id-after-reconnect
traces.description: A stream id reused in a new epoch is a new stream: the old flow's calls, carrying the old lease, change nothing.

traces.name: dropped-echo-field-is-invalid
traces.description: A post-open call carries its stream id, lease id and revision only; a lease fact beside them is an unknown member.

traces.name: lease-checked-before-expiry
traces.description: A call whose lease isn't its stream's gets lease_mismatch even once the stream has expired, since RFC §11 checks the lease before expiry: a stale flow learns that its lease is gone.

traces.name: channel-checked-before-expiry
traces.description: A late call on an expired stream whose channel has since been removed gets the channel's refusal, since RFC §11 checks the lease's own channel and sender before expiry.
